description.value: Spin Roll is a compact sushi and Japanese restaurant on West Pender Street in downtown Vancouver, offering an extensive menu of rolls, nigiri, sashimi, bento boxes, and rice bowls. It operates as a quick-service counter with online ordering and fast pickup, making it a convenient refuelling stop for cyclists moving through the city core. The menu spans budget-friendly staples to more substantial combos, with clearly labelled vegetarian choices throughout.
